name: Mazho Meqrin
source:
[i]"I always pay it back double, whether it's a favor, or I've been wronged. That's how we do it back in Fei Ying."[/i]

[i]Sword-Wielding Peacock[/i]

A man with roots in the neighboring country of Fei Ying.

He dresses flamboyantly and carries a sword, which makes him stand out in a crowd. He's loyal to his motto of paying things back, whether it be favors or revenge. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
